title: Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers
abstract: arXiv:2610.15501v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models make decisions through parallel prefill and sequential decoding. Although effective, this approach incurs decoding costs and does not explicitly expose decision probabilities. Existing task-specific classifiers require per-task training and offer limited generalization to unseen decision schemas. We propose Large Decision Models (LDMs), repurposing language models to return explicit probabilities over labels specified at run time using one prefill forward pass. We first adapt models to this interface through Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS), covering varied domains, rules and labels. To further narrow the performance gap to a reasoning model, Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD) adds tasks generated by a frozen teacher, filters them for answer consistency, and trains on label distributions obtained from repeated teacher reasoning. We evaluate on DecisionVista, pairing new-schema tests with held-out human-label

translated_title: 大决策模型：将大语言模型改造为单次前向传播决策器
translated_abstract: 大语言模型通过并行预填充和顺序解码来做出决策。尽管这种方法有效，但它会产生解码成本，且无法显式地暴露决策概率。现有的任务特定分类器需要针对每个任务单独训练，并且对未见过的决策模式泛化能力有限。我们提出了大决策模型，将语言模型重新改造，使其能够通过单次预填充前向传播，对运行时指定的标签返回显式概率。我们首先通过多样化决策监督（DDS）使模型适应这一接口，该监督涵盖多样的领域、规则和标签。为进一步缩小与推理模型的性能差距，自设推理蒸馏（SPRD）通过冻结的教师模型生成任务，对其进行答案一致性过滤，并利用从教师模型重复推理中获得的标签分布进行训练。我们在 DecisionVista 上进行评估，该基准将新模式测试与保留的人工标注相结合。
tldr: 该论文提出大决策模型，让大语言模型通过单次预填充前向传播直接输出对运行时指定标签的显式概率，并结合多样化决策监督与自设推理蒸馏两种训练方法，实现对未见决策模式的高效泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Large Decision Models (LDMs) that repurpose language models to output explicit probabilities over runtime-specified labels in a single prefill forward pass, trained via Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS) and Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD) to generalize efficiently to unseen decision schemas.
